So what makes a person or group ACTUALLY strong?

Strength is numbers, organization, and knowledge. Strength is the capacity to get things done. Strength is the ability to positively effect people's daily lives. This is why people are swayed by the mainstream media - because the media can actually reach them, while alternative media cannot.

  • Numbers

A king is not strong in himself. No matter his wisdom, charisma, or physical prowess, a lone individual can easily be overcome by his many enemies. A king's strength is in the thousands or millions of men he can command. The king who can control more men wins. This has been true since time began, in countless situations and contexts. One man doing one thing is not strong, especially if he suffers a negative consequence for it. Millions of people doing something is strong. This is why protests, demonstrations, and political gatherings always seek to have the biggest numbers.

  • Organization

While numbers are the determining factor, proper organization can turn a slight numerical advantage into an overwhelming one. Organization is the ability to bring people together and direct them towards a goal. If you have ever tried to organize a party or a group project, you know this is a lot more difficult than it sounds, and a good organizer is worth their weight in gold.

  • Knowledge

A group that is able to correctly predict the future or describe the present will be respected and listened to. It will also possess the advantage of knowing things its opponents do not.

We cannot have superior numbers at the moment, but we can have superior organization, competence, and knowledge.
